requirements.text: ### B. Backend integrity and recoverability
requirements.assessment: Section heading or formatting; not a completion claim

Use database transactions for atomic posting of full transfer pairs, no half-posted records, and single-use approval. requirements.assessment: Approval controls exist, but passkeys, hosted staging and all assistive hardware checks are not complete.

requirements.text: - Where passkey/WebAuthn is used, issue a fresh short-lived authentication challenge associated server-side with the exact proposal ID + version + digest and the verified session; after successful user verification, authorize only that proposal. requirements.section: 20. PRODUCT NORTH STAR AND SYSTEM OF RECORD (NEW — OVERRIDES LOOSELY WORDED PRIOR DESCRIPTIONS)
requirements.text: The app is NOT a generic expense logger with a chatbot on top. It is a customizable financial **planning and decision-support** system, guided by a conversational companion. Product pillars:
requirements.assessment: Manual subset has code/tests; this multi-clause statement is not fully satisfied across the complete product.

requirements.section: 20. PRODUCT NORTH STAR AND SYSTEM OF RECORD (NEW — OVERRIDES LOOSELY WORDED PRIOR DESCRIPTIONS)
requirements.text: 1. **Ledger = reality.** Authoritative accounting of what happened: account-opening snapshots, transactions, pending/cleared/posted states, paired transfers, credit card charges/payments, reconciliation history. It answers "What actually happened?" Never silently change posted history because AI predicts a different result.
requirements.assessment: Manual subset has code/tests; this multi-clause statement is not fully satisfied across the complete product.

requirements.section: 20. PRODUCT NORTH STAR AND SYSTEM OF RECORD (NEW — OVERRIDES LOOSELY WORDED PRIOR DESCRIPTIONS)

Comparison to actuals is feedback, not the budget's sole purpose. Flexible user-defined category names and budget periods. It answers "What am I trying to do, and how do I get there?"
requirements.assessment: Manual subset has code/tests; this multi-clause statement is not fully satisfied across the complete product.

requirements.section: 20. PRODUCT NORTH STAR AND SYSTEM OF RECORD (NEW — OVERRIDES LOOSELY WORDED PRIOR DESCRIPTIONS)
requirements.text: 3. **Forecaster = road ahead.** Daily cash position from ledger + approved future assumptions (income, bills, planned expenses, savings contributions, debt payments), confidence/coverage explanation, expected clearance timing, scenario ranges. It answers "If I stay on this path, what likely happens next?"
requirements.assessment: Manual subset has code/tests; this multi-clause statement is not fully satisfied across the complete product.

requirements.section: 20. PRODUCT NORTH STAR AND SYSTEM OF RECORD (NEW — OVERRIDES LOOSELY WORDED PRIOR DESCRIPTIONS)
requirements.text: 4. **Pip = companion.** Asks clarifying questions, notices uncertainty/opportunities, explains *why*, proposes multiple choices and lets customer deliberately approve exact drafts. Pip does not generate authoritative monetary math; typed deterministic engines do.
requirements.assessment: Manual subset has code/tests; this multi-clause statement is not fully satisfied across the complete product.

requirements.section: 20. PRODUCT NORTH STAR AND SYSTEM OF RECORD (NEW — OVERRIDES LOOSELY WORDED PRIOR DESCRIPTIONS)
requirements.text: **Data flow rule:** One posted $120 bank transaction is one actual $120 transaction, even if a receipt splits it into $82 groceries + $30 household + $8 allocated tax. Category allocations, budgets and forecasts are *views/analyses* of ledger data. They must not post another $120 debit. Expense categories cannot mutate account balance; savings goal allocations cannot independently create assets. A proposed reduction in spending is NOT yet saved money and does NOT change cash on hand.
